title: Efficiency of an ideal settling basin

symbols.definition: settling velocity of the particles to be removed
surface overflow rate, defined as the ratio of flow of sewage to be treated in an ideal settling tank to the plan area of the tank, i.e., Q/A

applicability: Efficiency of an ideal settling basin is expressed as the ratio of the settling velocity of the particles to be removed (Vs) to the surface overflow rate (Vo).
notes: Vo is printed with the letter o as subscript, not a zero; retained.
No separate symbol list is printed under equation (5.10); the definitions above are the printed prose definitions.
